Leah (PM): TL;DR: customers keep seeing console previews that don't match saved per-route queries (model mismatch). Can we make saved-query previews more faithful by default?

Vik (Backend): Short answer: yes. Problem is saved_query stores model_hint not deterministic_model_id. Options: persist exact model_version on pin OR run server-side preview that calls routing-service with a preview flag.

Ana (Console UX): UX should default to 'Preview as saved' when viewing a saved query. Add tiny toggle to switch to 'Live route' and a compact badge: Pinned / Route-default / Fallback. If the preview is approximate, show "approximate" label.

Marcus (Routing): We can expose routing-service.preview(simulate=true) which returns deterministic_model_id, policy_version, and a fallback_risk_bucket (low/med/high). That helps explain why runtime might differ.

June (Telemetry): Every preview call must include preview=true and preview_mode in events. Exclude previews from billing aggregates. Also emit preview_sample_id to join preview logs with real requests for debugging.

deploy-bot: routing-service.preview endpoint scheduled to canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

Vik (Backend): API sketch (strings only): POST /savedqueries/{id}/preview body: {mode: "saved"|"live"|"simulate", region_hint: "string"} resp: {model_used: "string", deterministic_model_id: "string", fallback_bucket: "low|med|high", policy_version: "string", est_tokens: "1000", p95_ms: "120", est_cost_cents: "12"} TTL 45s, rate-limit 10/min/user.

Ana (Console UX): Show provenance tooltip: "Calculated using policy vX; shows pinned model unless simulate indicates fallback." Microcopy: "Estimates are best-effort; actual routing may differ under load."

Leah (PM): Action items: Vik spec & auth; Marcus wire preview sim; Ana mock toggle + badge; June add telemetry keys + dashboard to detect preview leakage. I'll draft RFC after prototypes. Thanks! :raised_hands:

Vik (Backend): I'll add memoization and conservative quotas. Expect spec PR by EOD.
